spec.body_markdown: ## Vector Addition\n\nVectors add tip-to-tail (triangle law) or tail-to-tail with a diagonal (parallelogram law). Both give the same resultant. In components, R_x = A_x + B_x and R_y = A_y + B_y. Vector addition is commutative: A + B = B + A.
